The Saudi reckless young man, Aida, is an only child to an Egyptian mother and a Saudi father, who dreams of becoming one of the biggest car drivers in the world, which gets him into a series of trouble.
Lorsque le jeune homme d'affaires Yehia traverse une crise, il découvre que son seul espoir est une mystérieuse femme sainte nommée Rouh qui commence à l'aider.

Les événements du film se déroulent lors d'une croisière sur le Nil à bord d'un bateau, et une fraude inattendue se produit sur l'un des passagers du bateau, après quoi les événements se succèdent d'une manière comique pour révéler la vérité.

As Malek, a child, falls into a coma following a car accident unintentionally caused by his brother, his parents, Nader and Lamia, try to save the child s life, resorting to a solution that turns their lives upside down.
Un escroc professionnel tombe amoureux d'une femme qui travaille pour le compte d'une organisation criminelle.

A comedy about famous artist Zico, who's forced to marry (Bossy), as their grandfather stipulated in his will that they have to get married to have an inheritance of five million pounds , and as events develop their relation turns into true love.

Après l'effondrement de leur maison, l'ingénieur shérif vit avec sa famille dans un centre d'hébergement. Ils déménagent pour vivre dans le cimetière familial, mais ils découvrent que quelqu'un d'autre y vit. Sheriff se résout à concevoir une caravane et à y vivre, ce qui lui vaut de nouveaux ennuis.

Farhaan Melaazem Adam leaves Upper Egypt to Cairo hoping to find a better life. But his dreams are shattered when forced to live in a poor neighborhood. He falls in love with Fotna, the daughter of a street food vendor, and he begins to forget his cruel life and undergoes another transformation.

Safwat orders Magdy to assassinate Jalal Mahmoud, causing Magdy to struggle with what he should do, while Syrian refugee Dima, Safwat's wife, suffers from his cruelty and seeks a way to break free from his grasp.
Lorsque sa nouvelle épouse est désenchantée car il n'a pas su la protéger du danger, Omar demande l'aide d'un psychiatre excentrique pour la reconquérir.
L'œuvre tourne autour d'un grand-père qui a volé dans sa jeunesse un chef-d'œuvre rare appartenant à la défunte chanteuse Umm Kulthum.

Naima is responsible for seven children whose father is very negligent and morally corrupt. He attempts to find work abroad and he leaves his wife to raise the children on her own. For how long is she going to bear their burdens?

three brothers of the same father; But for different mothers, they are (Samir), who works as a stuntman in cinema, and (Shaheer), who loves music and is known for his many female relationships, (Bahair), who is the son of an aristocratic family. As a result of a mishandling of a time machine, they travel back in time to the day their father met the Three Mothers.

The events of the film take place in an interesting and dramatic format, where a group of girls and young men decide to spend a vacation in a boat and head to the open sea. They are unable to return, so they try to adapt until help arrives. During this time, their internal conflicts appear, and between each other, and sheds light on the lives of each of them. and his own problems.
Réalisateur : Sameh Abd El Aziz - Interprétation : Mohammed Saad- Dolly Shaheen - Année de production : 2013.
Après un accident, une femme devient aveugle et a perdu la mémoire : elle doit reconstruire le fil des événements passés.

Un jeune homme travaillant dans le port d'Alexandrie épouse sa bien-aimée Bodour, ce que désire un haut fonctionnaire de l'Union socialiste qui, usant de son influence et avec l'aide de ses hommes, le met injustement en prison et le condamne à 25 ans. Il sort pour se venger de ceux qui lui ont fait du tort.
Raouf escapes his grandmother's control after her trip to Germany, but her return turns his and his wife's life upside down as she takes control.
Réalisateur : Ali Ragab - Interprétation : Tamer Hossni / Abla Kamel / Nour - Année de production : 2005.
Une fillette de 10 ans, élevée dans une famille conservatrice de Riyad, décide de faire tout ce qu'elle peut pour s'acheter le vélo de ses rêves.

after 5 years from part 1, Yehia marries Lobna and is called to the dangerous cases department. to find who manipulates him and his family's so he used the blue elephant pills to solve the puzzles he faces.

Hussein, an honest teacher, suffers from his ambitious wife who dreams of wealth. When a wealthy friend of his returns to Egypt, Hussein introduces him to his wife, and a romantic relationship develops between the two.
Two identical twins get separated from the orphanage. One of them is adopted by a poor dancer and becomes a drug addict, while the other is adopted by a police officer and becomes a policeman.

Une organisation internationale a pris Mustafa pour cible en raison de sa contribution scientifique à la recherche de médicaments contre le cancer et le sida. Il s'échappe et fait semblant d'avoir perdu la mémoire, vivant dans une décharge jusqu'à ce qu'il termine ses recherches.

Badr Al-Deezel vit dans un quartier populaire, il rencontre la célèbre star de cinéma Donia Al-Siyadiya, dont son fiancé Afaf est l'assistant. Afaf est assassinée, ce qui pousse Badr à se venger de celui qui l'a tuée.
A horror feature that tells the story of Ezz El-Din, who returns from abroad after many years, looking for his family, and while staying at his family's mansion, he discovers an unexpected adventure.
